To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the functionalization of carbon nanotubes can improve the interfacial shear properties of carbon nanotubepolyethylene nanocomposite.
functionalizing the CNTs enhances their interfacial shear strengths at different temperatures and the interfacial properties of nanocomposite are highly dependent on the CNT chirality.

functionalizing the pristine carbon nanotubes with a carboxylic group enhances its interfacially bonding with polyethylene matrix, and it is also found that interfacial interaction energies and interfacial strengths of the nanocomposites are highly sensitive to temperature and chirality of carbon nanotubes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the interfacial shear behavior of functionalized and pristine carbon nanotubes in a nanocomposite at various temperatures.
the interfacial properties of functionalized carbon-nanotube–reinfroced nanocomposite at various temperatures.
the effect of functionalization and chirality on the interfacially bonded carbon nanotube-polyethylene nanocomposite.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the functionalized carbon nanotope–reinforced polymer nanocomposite has higher interfacial interaction strength than pristine carbon nanotubes–reinforced one at different temperatures.

functionalization of carbon nanotubes in the nanocomposite enhances the interfacial shear stress of the nanocomposites at all temperatures, especially at low temperatures, which can be used in the fabrication of nanocomposites for applications at low temperatures.
functionalizing the pristine carbon nanotubes in the polyethylene matrix enhances the interfacial shear strengths of the nanocomposites at different temperatures.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the interfacial shear behavior of carbon nanotubes in polymer matrices can be enhanced by functionalizing the nanotubes.
the functionalization of carbon nanotubes in carbon nanotubes–polyethylene nanomaterials is an effective way to improve their interfacial properties at different temperatures.
functionalization of carbon nanotubes in the carbon nanotubes–polyethylene nanofibers can enhance its interfacial interaction at different temperatures.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the temperature has a considerable effect on the interfacal behavior of carbon nanotubes–reinforced polyethylene nanocomposite, which should be considered for designing and fabricating carbon nanotube/polyethylene-based nanocomposites.
carbon nanotube functionalization can be used as an effective strategy to improve the interfacial properties of the nanocomposites at different temperatures.
